notes.1: Accepted: 259.5(b)(5) word for word (it ends with the regulation's own semicolon, hence intake's warning that it may be cut short).

Accepted: 259.5(b)(5) as amended on 2024-06-25, word for word, as a new version of REF-001. Its one parameter, optional_service_fee_refund_required = false, is wrong (fee refunds are still due, now under part 260); corrected below.

changes.clause_text: Providing prompt refunds in the original form of payment (i.e., money is returned to an individual using whatever payment method the individual used to make the original payment, such as a check, credit card, debit card, cash, or airline miles) when ticket or ancillary service fee refunds, including checked bag fee refunds, are due pursuant to 14 CFR part 260 unless the consumer agrees to receive the refunds in a different form of payment that is a cash equivalent payment as defined in 14 CFR 260.2. Carriers may not retain a processing fee for issuing refunds that are due;
changes.change_note: 259.5(b)(5) as amended: parameter corrected by the editor (no processing fee; fee refunds still due)
changes.why: Same text. The proposal's optional_service_fee_refund_required = false says the opposite of the text, which still makes ticket and ancillary fee refunds due (under part 260); replaced with processing_fee_allowed = false ('Carriers may not retain a processing fee for issuing refunds that are due'). Neither key has a rule-checker cue, so no check changes; the data is right. Db2 labels the corrected row v3.
